name: cmake
description: A modern toolset used for generating Makefiles and other build systems.
build: cd cmake-4.2.3 && sed -i '/"lib64"/s/64//' Modules/GNUInstallDirs.cmake && LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/usr/lib ./bootstrap --prefix=/usr --system-libs --mandir=/share/man --no-system-jsoncpp --no-system-cppdap --no-system-librhash --docdir=/share/doc/cmake-4.2.3 && make $MAKEOPTS
